property_summary: For every caller and observed key, calling Deposit with msg.value == 0 is a no-op on the reference (balances[k] unchanged and call does not revert); the mutant adds require(msg.value>0) so a zero-value Deposit reverts, breaking the no-op property for some inputs.
change_summary: Make Deposit non-payable check effectively require positive value by inserting a require that msg.value > 0 causing revert for zero-value calls.
